transcript: Speaker A: पांच बच्चों के साथ ट्रेन में अकेला छोड़ गया। अस्सलाम वालेकुम, मेरा नाम सायरा है... [Left me alone in the train with five children. Assalamu Alaikum, my name is Saira...] (She narrates her husband abandoning her, her struggles to find a job without English, and how she learned English using the English Seekho app's AI coach to secure a job and support her five children.)
summary: A woman shares her emotional story of being abandoned by her husband with five children and facing severe hardships due to her inability to speak English. She explains how downloading the English Seekho app and practicing daily helped her secure a call center job, gain financial independence, and educate her children, concluding with a call to action to download the app.
